Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Lab test booking details. bookingDate/slotStart/slotEnd were added in 2026-05; older bookings may not have them (legacy).

patientId.description: Required for new bookings — links to /users/{userId}/patients/{patientId}.

timeSlot.description: Human-readable label like '7:00 AM – 8:00 AM'. Derived from slotStart/slotEnd at write time for new bookings; preserved as-is on legacy bookings.

bookingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Kolkata. Optional for legacy bookings only.

slotStart.description: HH:mm 24h, e.g. '07:00'. Canonical occupancy key paired with bookingDate.

PatientProfile.title: Patient Profile
PatientProfile.description: Stored patient information for a specific user

Staff.title: Staff
Staff.description: Admin or phlebotomist staff member. defaultSchedule is consulted when no per-date override exists in phlebAvailability.

defaultSchedule.description: Per-weekday list of slotStart values this phleb works by default. Empty array = off that weekday.

BookingConfig.title: BookingConfig
BookingConfig.description: Singleton at config/booking. Admin-edited slot template and booking window. Both bot implementations (server + simulator) read this on entry to the date/slot picker.

maxAdvanceDays.description: How many days ahead customers may book (1–30).

timezone.description: Display tz, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. All date arithmetic is single-tz.

PhlebAvailability.title: PhlebAvailability
PhlebAvailability.description: Per-date override of a phleb's working slots. Sparse: a document is created only when admin deviates from the staff defaultSchedule. Resolution order at query time: override doc (if exists) > staff.defaultSchedule[weekday] > empty.

workingSlots.description: slotStart values worked on this date.

/users/{userId}/patients/{patientId}.description: Patient profiles managed by the user

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Test booking records. Slot occupancy for (phleb, date, slot) is derived by querying this collection — there is no separate inventory.

/staff/{uid}.description: Internal staff (admins & phlebotomists). uid is the Firebase Auth uid.

/config/booking.description: Singleton booking configuration document. Seed via scripts/seed-booking-config.ts; edit via the admin Settings tab.

/phlebAvailability/{date_phlebUid}.description: Composite-id document overriding a phleb's effective slots for a specific date. Sparse — most (phleb, date) pairs have no doc and fall back to staff.defaultSchedule.
